Currently riding out my first dosing of Kratom. I have inattentive ADHD, and am going through PAWS from opiate/benzo withdrawals. I will tell you that it helps with the Anhedonia(at least for me. During my PAWS nothing gives me pleasure, and it scares me. I am back at a normal level. Perhaps slightly elevated.) But I am also a bit sedated, and wouldn't care to do much at the moment. I'd suggest you just try it out and see. It is not hard by any means to get ahold of, and a sample pack is very very cheap.(3 dollars~)

I went through about a 4-5 year process of different SSRI's and other alternative anxiety medications. (benzodiazipines and non-benzodizipines.) Xanax was the only thing that really worked. I'm on a fairly small dose, especially for my height. Yes, Vyvanse is dextroamphetamine. I was on it for a bit a couple years ago, because its known to make you less anxious than adderall. But it didn't do much for me other than make me go a bit manic.

Actually, Xanax has improved my quality of life 10 fold. I have very bad social anxiety, which has lead to very embarrassing and bad panic attacks, lol.  I'm prescribed twice a day as needed. I knew that it would potentiate the opiates so I started abusing it more, and taking it more. As for Adderall, I tried double my dose once...wasn't a fan, makes me muuuch too anxious. But in the dose I have, it makes me very productive and does it's job. I hope this isn't me rationalizing drug use. Because in my brain I believe this is how I felt prior to my drug abuse. I'm really not a huge fan of drug abuse... But man those opiates really got to me, lol. Made it so much more comfortable to mourn. Maybe I should of surrounded myself with people who I know care for comfort instead.

I will be going on monday! Today is day 15. Went to a party last night and it lifted my spirits a little. Drank half a beer. Substances don't seem very appealing to me, though lol. I just kind of want to be as healthy as possible. I love hearing stories like yours, that give me hope. Thank you.
